title: wkfind: Comprehensive Problem-Solving Framework
desc: Multi-angle code discovery and problem-solving tool combining git history, grep, web search, and intelligent code analysis
steps: Problem Definition Phase: Clarify what you're looking for vs what you're mistakenly doing. Use: Recent commits, git log search, initial grep
Multi-Angle Search Phase: Search from 5+ angles simultaneously: (1) git history/blame (2) code pattern matching (3) reference implementations (4) environment/process state (5) web search
Hypothesis & Validation: Form assumption about root cause, then validate using actual code and testing. Don't assume—verify.
Integration & Persistence Tracing: Trace data flow end-to-end: source detection → forwarding → consumption → persistence/logs. Verify each step.
Build, Deploy & Smoke Test: Compile changes, deploy to both bin directories, test with actual commands, check for regressions
Document Discovery: Update skills with methodology for reuse on similar problems. Capture what worked and what didn't.
tools: Git history: git log --grep, git show, git blame
Agent exploration: wkappbot agent 'problem description' --subagent Explore
search_strategies: Shallow (5min): git log + grep + 1-2 file reads
Medium (30min): git history + multi-angle grep + Agent Explore + 3-5 files
Deep (60min): full codebase search + triad consultation + web research
case_study_phases: Phase 1: Recognized GetForegroundWindow() returns current active window, not launcher's caller
Phase 2: Found Process.GetParentProcessId() reference in git blame, parallel grep searches
Phase 3: Validated hypothesis with MyCdpContext.ValidateCallerHwnd reference implementation
Phase 4: Traced forwarding: Program.cs → EyeCmdPipeClient.cs → CoreRunner.cs → Core usage
Phase 5: Built, deployed, verified cdp-state.jsonl persistence and Chrome placement
key_insights: Problem definition first: don't code until you understand what you're solving
Multi-angle search: use all available tools in parallel, not serially
Validation always: hypothesis-driven testing prevents dead-ends
End-to-end tracing: source → forwarding → consumption → persistence
Regression safety: build + test + smoke before declaring victory
